habit.description: After blocking a projectile the Oni dashes straight in. Throw a second projectile or meet the dash with a throw or anti-air before it arrives.

notes: Anti-air (YOK-165): answers opponent_jumping with oni-medium-punch (8f startup, club swing y170-270), the single attacking answer so jump_punish_pct sets the rate. Oni aggressive (Y2): dashes in constantly. Habit 70% so it is nameable in 2-3 fights. PROVISIONAL: data/moves/ has no Oni normals or Iron-Club Charge yet (clips blocked on concept art), so this uses only generic actions (walk, dash, jump, block, throw) and cannot strike at close range. When oni-* normals and special:iron-club-charge land, add close-range pokes and swap the whiff punish to the charge. No ids invented.
